message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta.  
Here’s how:

| Step | What to do | Contact |
|------|------------|---------|
| 1 | **Call 311** – Atlanta’s non-emergency hotline. Ask to speak with the Noise Control Unit. | 311 (or 404‑555‑1234) |
| 2 | **Use the online portal** – Atlanta’s official website offers a “Report a Complaint” form. Select “Noise” as the issue. | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 |
| 3 | **Visit the police station** – If you prefer in person, go to your nearest precinct and fill out a written complaint. | Precinct addresses on the city website |

The city’s noise ordinance covers excessive sound levels, especially during nighttime hours (typically 10 p.m.–7 a.m.). When filing, provide:

* Your name and address (optional but helpful)
* Date, time, and location of the disturbance
* Description of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs)
* Any evidence (photos, videos, audio recordings)

After submission, the police will investigate and may issue warnings or citations if the complaint is substantiated.
